why: Two config lines with their exact place and comment, a text test, and an e2e spec whose shape, addresses and thresholds are all given; both keys are typed in NextConfig, so a misplaced key fails the type check, and the build-warning grep plus the e2e spec catch a flag that does nothing. The docs edits are fixed text.
harm_if_wrong: At worst the router stops guessing routes everywhere, so client navigation is a little slower, which e2e and a revert both handle.
brief_problems: The fallback for a 404 on /category/hjem ('pick the first category the seed makes') is a small choice, though e2e/terms.spec.ts already uses /s/demo/no/category/hjem, so it should not come up
